ui.controls.stickHint: The stick appears where you touch
ui.controls.slowmo: Time slows down while you spin, flip or grab. Come up short on the landing and you slam.
ui.controls.charge: Hold to load the rope, release to pop. Hold through a kicker lip to go bigger.
ui.controls.surface180: Surface 180: to switch and back. Keeps the combo alive.
ui.controls.boneless: Boneless: hold FLIP while releasing JUMP — a planted pop, a bit higher.
ui.controls.spin: Spin: in the air hold the stick ← or → — it keeps adding 180° while held. Let go and it finishes the current half-turn.
ui.controls.invert: ↑ backroll, ↓ frontroll. Press again for a double. Off a kicker a backroll becomes a tantrum.
ui.controls.shifty: Stick neutral: tap for a shifty, hold for a raley (wakeboard).
ui.controls.grabs: Grabs: neutral Indy · ← Melon · → Mute · ↑ Nose · ↓ Tail · ↓ + side Stalefish. Longer hold, more points. Let go before you land!
ui.controls.flips: Flips: neutral Shuvit · ← Kickflip · → Heelflip · ↑ Impossible · ↓ 360 Flip.
ui.controls.catch: Catch it: press again when the board comes round (JUMP works too). Miss it and the board is gone.
ui.controls.balance: Balance: keep the marker in the middle of the bar.
ui.controls.boardslide: Hold the stick: ← boardslide, → lipslide. Let go — 50-50. Balance takes care of itself.
ui.controls.press: Hold the stick: ↑ nose press, ↓ tail press.
ui.controls.popOff: Pop off — and go straight into an air trick.
ui.controls.handle: Drop the handle and coast, press again to grab it back.
ui.controls.hero: HERO mode when the meter is full: ×2 points and super slow-mo for 8 seconds.

hud.tip.title: Tip
hud.tip.1: Hold JUMP to load the rope, let go to pop. The fuller the ring, the higher you fly.
hud.tip.2: In the air hold the stick ← or →: it keeps adding 180°. Let go when you have enough.
hud.tip.3: TRICK + ↑ in the air is a backroll, TRICK + ↓ a frontroll. Off a kicker the backroll becomes a tantrum.
hud.tip.4: Hold GRAB in the air: no stick — Indy, ← Melon, → Mute, ↑ Nose, ↓ Tail. Let go before you land!
hud.tip.5: On a rail TRICK + ←/→/↑/↓ is a boardslide, lipslide, noseslide or tailslide. GRAB + ←/→ — blunts.
hud.tip.6: The canal edges are rideable too: pop onto the quay edge and slide along the water.
hud.tip.7: On the water TRICK + ←/→ is a surface 180. It links tricks into one combo.
hud.tip.8: A combo lives 3 seconds between tricks. A fall burns every point in it.
hud.tip.9: HERO meter full? Hit HERO — 8 seconds of slow motion and double points.
hud.tip.10: The same trick twice in a row pays less and less. Mix it up to score more.
hud.tip.11: Collect W-H-Y-N-O-T in one run — it is one of the spot goals.
hud.tip.12: Hold JUMP all the way to the lip of a kicker to fly noticeably higher.
hud.moves.aheadKicker: Kicker — hold jump to the lip
ui.controls.blunts: ← nose blunt, → tail blunt. TRICK again — back to the stick.
hud.moves.aheadKickerSwipe: Kicker — swipe up at the lip

ui.endless.resultNote: Made it to stage {stage} · {metres} m on the water
ui.settings.controlSchemeHint: Swipes — one finger, like a runner. Classic — stick and buttons.
hud.tip.swipe: Swipe ↑ to jump, ←/→ to change lane. In the air swipes spin and flip you, hold to grab.
hud.tut.lane.swipe: Slide your finger right or left — the rider changes lane.
hud.tut.lane.classic: Move the stick left-right — the rider steers.
hud.tut.pop.classic: Hold JUMP and let go — pop. The longer you hold, the higher.
hud.tut.spin.swipe: While in the air, swipe sideways: a 180° spin. Another swipe — another 180°.
hud.tut.spin.classic: While in the air, TRICK + ← or →: spin. Or hold the stick sideways.
hud.tut.rail.swipe: Get in the rail’s lane and swipe UP right in front of it.
hud.tut.rail.classic: Steer to the rail and pop right in front of it.
hud.tut.slide.swipe: On the rail, swipe left — boardslide!
hud.tut.slide.classic: On the rail, hold the stick left — boardslide!
hud.tut.done.all: You know the basics. Collect W-H-Y-N-O-T and complete the spot goals!
